mapper.sql: t.id, t.project_id, p.project_name, t.template_name, t.spreadsheet_id, t.spreadsheet_name, t.sheet_id, t.sheet_title, t.header_row, CAST(t.field_mappings AS CHAR) AS field_mappings, t.enable_flag, t.created_by, t.updated_by, t.updated_at
FROM biz_delivery_report_google_template t JOIN pm_project p ON p.id = t.project_id AND p.deleted_at = 0 WHERE t.deleted_at = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm_project WHERE id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at = 0
SELECT customer_daily_report_url FROM pm_project WHERE id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_delivery_report_google_template ( project_id, template_name, spreadsheet_id, spreadsheet_name, sheet_id, sheet_title, header_row, field_mappings, enable_flag, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{templateName}, #{spreadsheetId}, #{spreadsheetName}, #{sheetId}, #{sheetTitle}, #{headerRow}, CAST(#{fieldMappings} AS JSON), #{enableFlag}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_delivery_report_google_template SET project_id = #{projectId}, template_name = #{templateName}, spreadsheet_id = #{spreadsheetId}, spreadsheet_name = #{spreadsheetName}, sheet_id = #{sheetId}, sheet_title = #{sheetTitle}, header_row = #{headerRow}, field_mappings = CAST(#{fieldMappings} AS JSON), enable_flag = #{enableFlag}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_delivery_report_google_push_item ( batch_id, report_id, project_id, template_id, spreadsheet_id, sheet_id, sheet_title, header_row, field_values, target_headers, unique_key_columns, report_id_column, status ) VALUES ( #{batchId}, #{reportId}, #{projectId}, #{templateId}, #{spreadsheetId}, #{sheetId}, #{sheetTitle}, #{headerRow}, CAST(#{fieldValues} AS JSON), CAST(#{targetHeaders} AS JSON), CAST(#{uniqueKeyColumns} AS JSON), #{reportIdColumn}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM biz_delivery_report_google_push_batch WHERE status = 0 ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_delivery_report_google_push_batch SET status = 1, started_at = NOW(3), finished_at = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, status, total_count, success_count, failed_count, requested_by, error_message, started_at, finished_at, created_at FROM biz_delivery_report_google_push_batch WHERE id = #{id} AND requested_by = #{userId}

SELECT id, batch_id, report_id, project_id, template_id, spreadsheet_id, sheet_id, sheet_title, header_row, CAST(field_values AS CHAR) AS field_values, CAST(target_headers AS CHAR) AS target_headers, CAST(unique_key_columns AS CHAR) AS unique_key_columns, report_id_column, status, target_row, attempt_count, error_message, started_at, finished_at FROM biz_delivery_report_google_push_item WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_delivery_report_google_push_item SET status = 1, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, started_at = NOW(3), finished_at = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE biz_delivery_report_google_push_item SET status = 2, target_row = #{targetRow}, finished_at = NOW(3), error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE biz_delivery_report_google_push_item SET status = 3, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1

UPDATE biz_delivery_report_google_push_batch b SET success_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_delivery_report_google_push_item i WHERE i.batch_id = b.id AND i.status = 2 ), failed_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_delivery_report_google_push_item i WHERE i.batch_id = b.id AND i.status = 3 ), status = CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM biz_delivery_report_google_push_item i WHERE i.batch_id = b.id AND i.status <> 2 ) THEN 2 WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM biz_delivery_report_google_push_item i WHERE i.batch_id = b.id AND i.status = 2 ) THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = NOW(3) WHERE b.id = #{id} AND b.status = 1
UPDATE biz_delivery_report_google_push_item SET status = 0, error_message = NULL, started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND status = 3

UPDATE biz_delivery_report_google_push_batch SET status = 0, success_count = 0, failed_count = 0, error_message = NULL, started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND requested_by = #{userId} AND status IN (3, 4)

UPDATE biz_delivery_report_google_push_item i JOIN biz_delivery_report_google_push_batch b ON b.id = i.batch_id SET i.status = 0, i.started_at = NULL, i.finished_at = NULL, i.error_message = '上次执行中断，已自动重新排队' WHERE b.status = 1 AND b.started_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(3), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AND i.status = 1

UPDATE biz_delivery_report_google_push_batch SET status = 0, started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, error_message = '上次执行中断，已自动重新排队' WHERE status = 1 AND started_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(3), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)
